Mathematica is a powerful computational software that can perform various mathematical operations, including finding the greatest common divisor (GCD) of two numbers. To find the GCD of 27 and 36, you can use the `GCD` function in Mathematica. Here's how you can do it:

```mathematica
GCD[27, 36]
```

When you run this code, Mathematica will return the GCD of 27 and 36, which is 9.
